findings.claim: Original whole-polygon eligibility requires projected-Y score=4-N, both corner distances<0 and equal masked shade bands; only zero whole-emitter return enters fallback after an attempt.
findings.limitations: Bounded original-instruction emulation with controlled root, explicit OS/CRT/resource/numerical services and original source/post-transform inputs. Numerical model has stated comparison bounds. Shade/high are supplied diagnostic controls, not mission lighting/resource provenance. Additional-center/corner-end anchors, degenerate/tie behavior, general bin rejection and downstream rendering remain unresolved.
